citations.citation: For the invention of the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock and its development to the 10^-18 level, opening precision tests of gravity and many-body physics with atomic clocks
For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, whose magic-wavelength trapping brought optical timekeeping to the 10^-18 level
For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which magic-wavelength trapping of neutral atoms brought time and frequency measurement to the 10^-18 level
For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which neutral atoms trapped at the magic wavelength brought optical time and frequency measurement to the 1e-18 level
For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which neutral atoms trapped at the magic wavelength made atomic timekeeping at the 10^-18 level possible
For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which atoms trapped at a magic wavelength brought optical timekeeping to the 10^-18 level.

for the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which atoms trapped at the magic wavelength brought optical timekeeping to the 1e-18 level and opened clock comparisons that test relativity and many-body physics
